branches_location_ck.name: branches_location_ck
branches_location_ck.value: (latitude is null) = (longitude is null) and (latitude is null or (latitude between 6 and 38 and longitude between 68 and 98))

branches_commission_ck.name: branches_commission_ck
branches_commission_ck.value: commission_bps is null or commission_bps between 0 and 5000

coupons_discount_ck.name: coupons_discount_ck
coupons_discount_ck.value: (discount_type = 'percent' and percent_bps between 100 and 10000 and flat_minor is null) or (discount_type = 'flat' and flat_minor >= 100 and percent_bps is null)

documents_review_ck.name: documents_review_ck
documents_review_ck.value: (status in ('approved','rejected')) = (reviewed_at is not null) or status in ('expired','superseded')

documents_reject_reason_ck.name: documents_reject_reason_ck
documents_reject_reason_ck.value: status <> 'rejected' or rejection_reason is not null

ledger_order_type_uq.name: ledger_order_type_uq
ledger_order_type_uq.where: order_id is not null and type in ('order_earning','commission','commission_tax','restaurant_discount')

orders_total_ck.name: orders_total_ck
orders_total_ck.value: total_minor = subtotal_minor + packaging_fee_minor + delivery_fee_minor + platform_fee_minor + tax_minor + tip_minor - discount_minor

users_identity_ck.name: users_identity_ck
users_identity_ck.value: phone_e164 is not null or email is not null
